alkylation reagent: Iodoacetamide was then added to 20 mM, incubated for 25 min at room temperature in the dark
alkylation concentration: Iodoacetamide was then added to 20 mM
cleavage agent: digested at room temperature for 13 h with Lys-C protease at a 100:1 protein-to-protease ratio. Trypsin was then added at a 100:1 ratio
collision energy: fragmentation by higher energy collisional dissociation (HCD, normalized collision energy 32%)
enrichment method: homogenates from these cell lines were subjected to immunoprecipitation with anti-HA antibodies in the absence of detergent
fragmentation method: fragmentation by higher energy collisional dissociation (HCD, normalized collision energy 32%)
instrument: Mass spectrometric data were collected on an Exploris480 mass spectrometer
labeling: analysis of the samples by tandem mass tag-labeling and mass spectrometry
reduction reagent: treated for reductive alkylation by incubation with 5 mM fresh DTT for 1 h at 37 °C
reduction concentration: incubation with 5 mM fresh DTT for 1 h at 37 °C
